name: Type 2 diabetes: sodium ceiling
rationale: People with diabetes are advised to keep sodium below 2,300 mg a day, the same limit as for the general population.

name: Type 2 diabetes: minimum fibre
rationale: Aim for at least 14 g of fibre per 1,000 kcal, mainly from whole grains, legumes, vegetables and fruit.
source_locator: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026, Section 5 (doi:10.2337/dc26-S005), nutrition/MNT recommendations. DRAFT: figure taken from secondary summaries and ADA patient-education material; primary section text NOT read, verify before approval.

name: Type 2 diabetes: no fixed carbohydrate percentage
rationale: There is no single ideal split of carbohydrate, protein and fat for diabetes; the amount and type of carbohydrate should be individualised with a dietitian.
source_locator: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026, Section 5 (doi:10.2337/dc26-S005), nutrition/MNT recommendations. name: Type 2 diabetes: avoid sugar-sweetened drinks
rationale: Choose water or zero-calorie drinks instead of sugar-sweetened drinks.
